messages:
frank: quick follow-up from today's all-hands  super short: what release cadence should teams plan for next quarter, and who owns pages during canaries? also, what's the absolute minimum quality bar to start a canary?

elaine_cto: TL;DR: feature cadence = monthly (aim first week). patches/hotfix lane is available weekly; emergency fast-path always open.

maria_gonzalez: adding specifics: we expect a 10-day feature-freeze before ship week for feature releases. Canary is the default rollout for non-security changes.

sam_sre: Oncall/handoff: the PR field "canary_owner" is the active pager for the canary window. Owner must post a kickoff message in #eng-oncall and set an explicit PD schedule if pairing is needed. If the PR touches SLA-tagged routes, CC SRE lead before promoting beyond 15% traffic.

frank: what are the actual gates? numbers please.

maria_gonzalez: Primary gates (minimum required to start): CI smoke green, core regression subset green, P95 latency <= 1.10x baseline, service error delta < 0.08% absolute, and zero customer-facing regressions on smoke jobs. For inference/model changes we also require a quick eval run with no regressions on the agreed prompt set.

release-helper-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-handbook (freeze checklist + PR template) :link:

product-ops: is there a short PR body snippet engineers can paste? many teams ask for copy/paste.

maria_gonzalez: here's a compact PR snippet to drop into rollout PRs (paste as-is):

```
canary_owner: @username
canary_window_utc: 2026-12-01T18:00Z
initial_traffic: 5%
ramp_plan: 5% -> 20% over 8h -> 50% over next 18h (adjust per risk)
health_gates: ci_smoke, reg_subset, p95_latency, svc_error_delta, model_eval_if_applicable
rollback_plan: revert PR + disable routing; notify SRE if SLA routes listed
sla_routes_impacted: [list/paths]
notes: known issues / flaky tests
```

sam_sre: practical clarifications:
- Canary pairing: strongly encouraged for the first 2 hours on infra or model changes.
- Flaky test policy: if a flaky test appears after canary start and affects signals, pause promotion, quarantine test in CI, open a P1 ticket, triage within 3h. If metrics remain ambiguous after 30m of instability, roll back.

elaine_cto: SLA note: engineering goal for SLA-monitored routes is <=10% increase in P99 post-deploy; treat SLA-tagged routes as high-sensitivity and escalate early. Legal/ops will finalize contract language.

frank: thanks  i'll summarize and post a short note in the all-hands follow-up doc. can someone add the PR snippet to the official template?

product-ops: on it  will update template and add a 30min office hour next week to walk through canary-owner expectations.

release-helper-bot: Reminder: next oncall rotation begins 1987680000.

frank: perfect, closing thread after the office hour note is live. thanks!
